'''PacifikBreez When Ewoks Attack.... Totally man''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[PacifikBreez]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''Side:''' [[Light]] (inferred from the title)

== Introduction ==

Before you read:

What my local group considers a tournament deck is obviously much different from what most of you do.  The deck obviously isn't tier 1 amazing, but at the same time not a total fun/theme deck.  Gotta have some big guns and some sol…

The deck page itself was not captured by the Wayback Machine, so only the listing-page entry (title, author, date and blurb) survives; the card list is lost.


== Notes ==

* Listing-only entry: the GPN listing page 1 records this deck, but the deck page itself was never captured by the Wayback Machine (checked 11 October 2026), so the card list is lost. The side is inferred from the published title.
